samples: This module computes a stable build order from a dependency map, ensuring every step appears only after all of its prerequisites and breaking ties alphabetically. It first rejects any dependency that is missing from the input, then repeatedly collects all currently ready steps until either everything is ordered or a cycle is detected. The sample `main` function prints the ordered steps for a small project, so it is useful if you need a deterministic topological sort with clear errors for bad input.

This module computes a stable build order for a set of steps with dependencies, using alphabetical tie-breaking when multiple steps are ready at once. It first rejects any dependency that is not defined, then repeatedly picks all steps whose prerequisites are already scheduled, or fails with a cycle error if nothing can be chosen. Its `main` function demonstrates the algorithm by ordering a sample project and printing the numbered result to the console.

This module computes a stable build order from a dependency map, ensuring every step appears after all of its prerequisites and breaking ties alphabetically. It first rejects any reference to a dependency that is not defined, and if no valid ordering exists it fails with a cycle error listing the remaining steps. Its `main` function demonstrates the algorithm on a sample project and prints the resulting sequence to the console.
